shared_elements: carved stone monument with relief/sculpted imagery
zoomorphic creature with a large head and toothed/fanged mouth
reptilian or saurian jaws shown in profile
incised linear detailing (bands, teeth, scale-like markings)
justification: Both depict a large-headed zoomorph with an open, toothed profile snout and incised linear surface detail, which is a moderately specific shared motif. But A is a single low-relief creature spread horizontally along a boulder with elaborate scroll/panel motifs behind the head, while B is a three-dimensional composition of a crouching figure surmounted by a second, distinct creature head — a vertical stacked figural arrangement with no counterpart in A.
